mechanism: Chlorthalidone can cause hypokalemia and hyponatremia which may potentiate sumatriptan's vasoconstrictive effects and increase cardiovascular risk; additionally, thiazide diuretics may reduce sumatriptan efficacy through fluid/electrolyte depletion.
action: Monitor blood pressure and electrolytes regularly; ensure adequate hydration; consider alternative antimigraine therapy if frequent sumatriptan use is needed; assess cardiovascular risk factors before combined use.
